name: L-X1
description: L-X1, also referred to as Lexi, was an announcer droid at the Grand Arena on Vespaara together with Boz Vega. L-X1 was an apparent fan of the Hunter J-3DI, keeping a figurine of him on her desk, and commenting on his performance during exhibitions. L-X1 has also stated that "Trophy Chase" is one of her favorite arena games.
